title: Famicom Tantei Club Part II
description: Famicom Tantei Club Part II: Ushiro ni Tatsu Shōjo is a text-based adventure game released by Nintendo in 1989 for the Family Computer Disk System. The original version was released on two disks in 1989, and the game was ported to the Super Famicom and the Game Boy Advance several years later. The Super Famicom version was released in Japan for the Wii's Virtual Console on April 30, 2008, and Wii U's Virtual Console on July 31, 2013.The Famicom version was released for the Virtual Console on December 22, 2009. Neither version of the game was ever released outside Japan.
